stress_anxiety.name: Child's Pose
stress_anxiety.benefits: Calms nervous system, releases back tension
stress_anxiety.instructions: Kneel on the floor, sit back on your heels, and fold forward with arms extended or by your sides. Rest forehead on the floor. Breathe deeply.

stress_anxiety.name: Legs Up The Wall
stress_anxiety.instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, then swing legs up the wall as you lie back. Keep arms at sides, palms up. Close eyes and breathe deeply. One of the most effective restorative poses.

stress_anxiety.name: Corpse Pose
stress_anxiety.instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms at sides, palms up, and legs comfortably apart. Close eyes and systematically relax each body part from toes to head.

stress_anxiety.name: Cat-Cow
stress_anxiety.instructions: Start on hands and knees. Inhale, arch back and look up (Cow). Exhale, round spine and tuck chin (Cat). Flow between the two with breath.

stress_anxiety.name: Standing Forward Bend
stress_anxiety.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Fold forward from hips, letting head and arms hang. Bend knees if hamstrings are tight. Let gravity do the work.

stress_anxiety.name: Bridge Pose
stress_anxiety.instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat. Press feet into floor, lift hips toward ceiling. Clasp hands under back or keep arms at sides. Breathe deeply.

stress_anxiety.name: Reclining Bound Angle
stress_anxiety.instructions: Lie on back, bring soles of feet together and let knees drop open to sides. Place pillows under knees for support if needed. Arms at sides, palms up.

strength_tone.name: Plank Pose
strength_tone.instructions: Start in push-up position. Keep body in a straight line from head to heels. Engage core, squeeze glutes, and hold. Don't let hips sag.

strength_tone.name: Chaturanga
strength_tone.instructions: From plank, lower body halfway down (like bottom of a push-up), keeping elbows close to ribs and body in a straight line. Key transition in Sun Salutations.

strength_tone.name: Warrior I
strength_tone.benefits: Legs, core, balance, hip flexor stretch
strength_tone.instructions: Step one foot back into a lunge. Back foot angled 45 degrees. Square hips forward, raise arms overhead. Front knee at 90 degrees.

strength_tone.name: Warrior II
strength_tone.instructions: From a wide stance, turn front foot forward and back foot perpendicular. Bend front knee to 90 degrees. Extend arms parallel to floor, gaze over front hand.

strength_tone.name: Warrior III
strength_tone.instructions: From standing, hinge forward at hips while lifting back leg until body forms a T shape. Arms extended forward or at sides. Engage standing leg and core.

strength_tone.name: Chair Pose
strength_tone.instructions: Stand with feet together. Bend knees and lower hips as if sitting in an invisible chair. Raise arms overhead. Keep weight in heels.

strength_tone.name: Boat Pose
strength_tone.instructions: Sit with knees bent. Lean back slightly and lift feet off floor. Extend legs (or keep bent for modification). Arms parallel to floor. Balance on sit bones.

strength_tone.name: Crow Pose
strength_tone.instructions: Squat with hands on floor shoulder-width apart. Place knees on backs of upper arms. Lean forward, shifting weight to hands, and lift feet off floor.

strength_tone.name: Side Plank
strength_tone.instructions: From plank, shift weight to one hand and rotate body to side. Stack feet or stagger them. Raise top arm to ceiling. Engage entire core.

flexibility_mobility.name: Downward Dog
flexibility_mobility.instructions: From hands and knees, tuck toes and lift hips high, forming an inverted V. Press hands into floor, push hips back and up. Pedal feet if hamstrings are tight.

flexibility_mobility.name: Pigeon Pose
flexibility_mobility.instructions: From downward dog, bring one knee forward behind the wrist. Extend back leg behind you. Square hips and fold forward over front shin.

flexibility_mobility.name: Seated Forward Bend
flexibility_mobility.instructions: Sit with legs extended. Inhale to lengthen spine, exhale to fold forward from hips. Reach for feet or shins. Don't round the back; lead with the chest.

flexibility_mobility.name: Cobra / Upward Dog
flexibility_mobility.benefits: Spine extension, hip flexors, chest opening
flexibility_mobility.instructions: Lie face down, place hands under shoulders. Press up, lifting chest while keeping hips on floor (Cobra) or lifting everything off floor (Upward Dog). Open chest.

flexibility_mobility.name: Butterfly
flexibility_mobility.instructions: Sit with soles of feet together, knees dropped to sides. Hold feet and sit tall. Gently press knees toward floor using elbows or allow gravity to open hips.

flexibility_mobility.name: Spinal Twist
flexibility_mobility.instructions: Sit with one leg extended, cross other foot over to outside of extended knee. Twist torso toward bent knee, using opposite elbow on outside of knee for leverage.

flexibility_mobility.name: Triangle Pose
flexibility_mobility.instructions: Stand in wide stance, front foot forward, back foot perpendicular. Extend arms, then hinge at hip to reach front hand toward floor/shin. Top arm extends to ceiling.

better_sleep.name: Legs Up The Wall
better_sleep.benefits: The #1 sleep yoga pose. Activates parasympathetic nervous system, drains lymphatic fluid from legs, reduces anxiety.
better_sleep.instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, swing legs up the wall as you lie back. Close eyes, breathe deeply, and allow complete relaxation.

better_sleep.name: Supine Spinal Twist
better_sleep.benefits: Releases spinal tension, calms the nervous system
better_sleep.instructions: Lie on back, draw one knee to chest and guide it across the body to the opposite side. Extend arms in T position. Turn head opposite to knee. Breathe deeply.

better_sleep.name: Happy Baby
better_sleep.benefits: Hip release, calming, lower back relief
better_sleep.instructions: Lie on back, draw knees toward armpits. Grab the outer edges of feet with hands. Gently rock side to side for a soothing stretch.

better_sleep.name: Forward Fold (seated)
better_sleep.benefits: Activates parasympathetic nervous system, calms the mind
better_sleep.instructions: Sit with legs extended. Fold forward from hips, resting on thighs. Hold and breathe deeply. The forward fold signals the body to rest.

better_sleep.name: Shavasana with body scan
better_sleep.benefits: Progressive relaxation, direct transition into sleep
better_sleep.instructions: Lie flat on back. Starting from toes, progressively relax each body part. Bring awareness to each area, tense briefly, then release. Let go completely.

digestive_health.name: Wind Relieving Pose
digestive_health.benefits: Gas and bloating relief, abdominal massage
digestive_health.instructions: Lie on back, draw one knee to chest and hug it close. Press thigh gently into abdomen. Hold and breathe. Repeat on other side, then both knees together.

digestive_health.name: Seated Twist
digestive_health.instructions: Sit with one leg extended, cross other foot over. Twist torso toward bent knee. The wringing action stimulates digestive organs.

digestive_health.name: Bow Pose
digestive_health.instructions: Lie face down, bend knees, reach back and grab ankles. Lift chest and thighs off the floor simultaneously, creating a bow shape. Rock gently.

digestive_health.name: Camel Pose
digestive_health.benefits: Stretches digestive organs, opens chest and abdomen
digestive_health.instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart. Place hands on lower back for support. Arch back, reaching hands toward heels. Open chest toward ceiling.

digestive_health.name: Deep Squat
digestive_health.benefits: Natural defecation posture, hip opening, stimulates elimination
digestive_health.instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips, toes turned out. Squat down as deep as possible. Press elbows against inner knees, palms together in prayer position.
